title: Government and Merit Scholarships Financial Aid
content: Students can avail various government scholarships including MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST, OBC, VJNT, and SBC categories, Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC) for open category students offering 50% tuition fee waiver, and Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance. Merit scholarships are also awarded to college toppers.
